title: Vampire 10K Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Vampire 10K Prefilled Pod Kit marks a bold new chapter for the iconic UK brand, combining its celebrated e-liquid expertise with a sleek, long-lasting prefilled pod system. Each pod delivers Vampire signature flavour precision through a dual mesh coil and an advanced Turbo Mode for intensified performance and taste clarity. Built around a rechargeable 950mAh battery, the device features an LCD display that clearly shows puff count, mode, and battery level, while the brushed metallic satin finish adds a refined feel. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, the Vampire 10K delivers discreet vapour, smooth satisfaction, and dependable all-day use. Each prefilled pod provides 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid (2ml pod + 10ml refill) and can deliver up to 10,000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal use. When flavour fades or vapour output drops, simply replace the pod with a fresh Vampire 10K Prefilled Pod in your chosen flavour. Please Note: This kit does NOT come with a USB-C cable Vampire 10K Kits Flavours • Red Raspberry Blast Bright and juicy Raspberry flavour with a tangy edge and smooth finish. • Sweet & Sour Cherry Tart Cherry flavour balanced by a mellow sweetness for a rounded fruit vape. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Sweet Blueberry fused with sharp Raspberry for a vibrant mixed-berry blend. • Dragon Fruit Watermelon Smoothie Exotic Dragon Fruit and fresh Watermelon with a creamy smoothie twist. • Strawberry Ice Sweet, fresh Strawberries on inhale with a cool, icy finish. • Pineapple Ice Juicy golden Pineapple lifted by a frosty exhale. • Mint Mojito Crisp Mint and Lime notes for a cool, refreshing vape. • Watermelon Ice Light, delicately sweet Watermelon flavour with an icy lift. • Lemon & Lime Zesty Lemon and sharp Lime for a bright, clean citrus profile. • Raspberry Apple Juice Smooth Raspberry and crisp Apple for a sweet, refreshing blend. How to Use Vampire 10K Kit Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod firmly into the device. Step 2 Ensure the 10ml refill section is attached securely. Step 3 Inhale to activate and vape – no buttons or setup required. Step 4 Switch to Turbo Mode for enhanced flavour and vapour output. Step 5 Recharge via USB-C when required. ✅ You're all set!
